question: Identify patients who underwent laboratory testing in October 1991 and satisfy at least one of the following: (a) they are under 50 years old as of 1999, or (b) they have abnormal fibrinogen levels. Among these, further require that they have normal white blood cell counts and either a recorded diagnosis or were admitted to the hospital. Return their ID, sex, diagnosis, admission status, and age as of 1999.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    P."XCL_064" AS diagnosis,
    P."XCL_063" AS admission_status,
    1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS age_1999
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE L."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
  AND (
    1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") < 50
    OR (L."XCL_036" IS NOT NULL AND (L."XCL_036" < 200 OR L."XCL_036" > 400))
  )
  AND L."XCL_030" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
  AND (
    (P."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL AND P."XCL_064" != '')
    OR P."XCL_063" = '+'
  )

    1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") < 50
    OR (L."XCL_036" IS NOT NULL AND (L."XCL_036" < 200 OR L."XCL_036" > 400))
  )
  AND L."XCL_030" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
  AND (
    (P."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL AND P."XCL_064" != '')
    OR P."XCL_063" = '+'
  )
